name: flistxattr
synopsis: ssize_t flistxattr(int fd, char *_Nullable list, size_t size);
description: flistxattr() retrieves the list of extended attribute names associated with the file referred to by the file descriptor fd. It places the list of null-terminated names into the provided buffer and returns the size of the list on success. Names of extended attributes to which the process lacks access may be omitted.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the file to query for extended attributes.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Buffer to store the null-terminated list of extended attribute names.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the buffer in bytes.

return_value.success: Returns a nonnegative number indicating the size of the extended attribute name list.
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error.

errors.description: The size of the list of extended attribute names is larger than the maximum size allowed.
Extended attributes are not supported by the filesystem, or are disabled.
The size of the list buffer is too small to hold the result.

bugs: The VFS imposes a 64kB limit on the size of the extended attribute name list; if the total size of attribute names exceeds this, it is impossible to retrieve the full list.
